name: Santa Close: AI-visual visual novel
source:
Horror game about finding endings in the form of a visual novel about Santa Claus. Try to find all the endings in this visual novel where each image is generated by neural networks and where each of your actions affects further progress (well, or not each).

[From [url=https://foleps.itch.io/santa-close-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款以圣诞老人为主题、通过视觉小说形式探索不同结局的恐怖游戏。试着找齐所有结局吧：每一幅图像都由神经网络生成，你的每一个行动都会影响后续进展——好吧，也不一定是每一个。

[摘自[url=https://foleps.itch.io/santa-close-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
